exercises.name: 90 hip switches
exercises.notes: Stand tall, hands on hips. Draw slow, wide circles with your hips like a hula hoop. Keep knees soft and core braced. 10 reps each direction.

exercises.name: Knee to wall ankle rocks
exercises.notes: Step into a forward lunge, rotate your torso over the front leg, then return to center as you step through to the next lunge. Keep the front knee tracking over the toes. 8 reps per side.

exercises.name: Monster walks
exercises.notes: Step into a forward lunge, rotate your torso over the front leg, then return to center as you step through to the next lunge. Keep the front knee tracking over the toes. 8 reps per side.

exercises.name: Tibialis raises
exercises.notes: Step into a forward lunge, rotate your torso over the front leg, then return to center as you step through to the next lunge. Keep the front knee tracking over the toes. 8 reps per side.

exercises.name: Box jumps
exercises.notes: Start in a quarter squat, swing arms back then forward as you jump onto the box. Land softly with bent knees, step back down. Reset fully between reps. 6-8 reps.

exercises.name: Broad jumps
exercises.notes: Push off one leg and hop laterally, landing on the opposite leg with a slight knee bend. Keep the trailing foot light behind you for balance. 10 reps per side.

exercises.name: Jump rope
exercises.notes: Push off one leg and hop laterally, landing on the opposite leg with a slight knee bend. Keep the trailing foot light behind you for balance. 10 reps per side.

exercises.name: Pogos
exercises.notes: Push off one leg and hop laterally, landing on the opposite leg with a slight knee bend. Keep the trailing foot light behind you for balance. 10 reps per side.

exercises.name: Skater jumps
exercises.notes: Push off one leg and hop laterally, landing on the opposite leg with a slight knee bend. Keep the trailing foot light behind you for balance. 10 reps per side.

exercises.name: Band external rotation
exercises.notes: Extend arms out to your sides and make small circles, gradually increasing size. 15 seconds forward, 15 seconds backward.

exercises.name: Face pulls
exercises.notes: Place forearm on a doorframe at shoulder height, step forward until you feel a stretch across the chest. Keep ribs down, don't arch the lower back. Hold 20-30 seconds per side.

exercises.name: Scapular push ups
exercises.notes: Place forearm on a doorframe at shoulder height, step forward until you feel a stretch across the chest. Keep ribs down, don't arch the lower back. Hold 20-30 seconds per side.

exercises.name: Medicine ball chest throw
exercises.notes: From a pushup position, lower with control then push explosively so hands leave the floor. Land soft with bent elbows. 5-8 reps.

exercises.name: Plyometric push ups
exercises.notes: From a pushup position, lower with control then push explosively so hands leave the floor. Land soft with bent elbows. 5-8 reps.

exercises.name: Band pull aparts
exercises.notes: On hands and knees, place one hand behind your head and rotate your elbow toward the ceiling, following with your eyes. 8 reps per side.

exercises.name: Dead hangs
exercises.notes: On hands and knees, place one hand behind your head and rotate your elbow toward the ceiling, following with your eyes. 8 reps per side.

exercises.name: Scapular pull ups
exercises.notes: On hands and knees, alternate between arching the back and rounding it, moving with your breath. 10 slow cycles.

exercises.name: Explosive pull ups
exercises.notes: Raise the ball overhead, then slam it down hard using your whole body, hinging at the hips. Catch the bounce and reset. 8-10 reps.

exercises.name: Medicine ball slams
exercises.notes: Raise the ball overhead, then slam it down hard using your whole body, hinging at the hips. Catch the bounce and reset. 8-10 reps.

exercises.name: Band pull aparts
exercises.notes: Hold a light band at shoulder height, arms extended. Pull the band apart by squeezing shoulder blades together, control the return. 12-15 reps.

exercises.name: Shoulder dislocates
exercises.notes: Hold a band or dowel with a wide grip. Raise it overhead and behind you without bending the elbows, then return to front. Widen your grip if the shoulders feel tight. 10 reps.

exercises.name: Plyo shoulder taps
exercises.notes: From a plank, alternate tapping the opposite shoulder with control, then add a small hop of the feet between taps. Keep hips square. 8 reps per side.

exercises.name: Ankle circles
exercises.notes: Lift one foot off the ground and circle the ankle.

exercises.name: Calf raises
exercises.notes: Stand on a flat surface or step edge, rise onto the balls of your feet, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Downward dog calf pumps
exercises.notes: From downward dog, alternately bend one knee then the other, pedaling the heels toward the floor.

exercises.name: Knee to wall ankle rocks
exercises.notes: Lift one foot off the ground and circle the ankle.

exercises.name: Short foot exercise
exercises.notes: Lift one foot off the ground and circle the ankle.

exercises.name: Single leg balance
exercises.notes: Lift one foot off the ground and circle the ankle.

exercises.name: Tibialis raises
exercises.notes: Lift one foot off the ground and circle the ankle.

exercises.name: Toe yoga
exercises.notes: Barefoot, practice lifting only your big toe while keeping the other toes down, then reverse. Improves foot control.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.notes: On hands and knees, extend one arm and the opposite leg while keeping your hips and shoulders square. Hold briefly, then switch.

exercises.name: Copenhagen plank
exercises.notes: Prop up on one forearm with feet stacked, lifting your hips into a straight line from head to feet.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.notes: Lie on your back, arms reaching up and knees bent at 90 degrees. Slowly lower opposite arm and leg toward the floor while keeping your lower back flat, then return.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.notes: Hold a band or cable at chest height, anchored to your side. Press it straight out in front of you, resisting the pull back toward the anchor.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.notes: Prop up on one forearm with feet stacked, lifting your hips into a straight line from head to feet.

exercises.name: Fire hydrant
exercises.notes: On hands and knees, keep the knee bent and lift one leg out to the side, leading with the knee. Keep hips level.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.notes: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Drive through your heels to lift your hips, squeezing the glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Monster walks
exercises.notes: On hands and knees, keep the knee bent and lift one leg out to the side, leading with the knee. Keep hips level.

exercises.name: Peterson step up
exercises.notes: On hands and knees, keep the knee bent and lift one leg out to the side, leading with the knee. Keep hips level.

exercises.name: Side lying leg raises
exercises.notes: On hands and knees, keep the knee bent and lift one leg out to the side, leading with the knee. Keep hips level.

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.notes: Standing on one leg, pull the opposite heel toward your glute, keeping knees together and hips forward.

exercises.name: Terminal knee extension
exercises.notes: Loop a band around a fixed point at knee height, step back to create tension, then straighten the knee against the resistance.

exercises.name: 90 90 hip switch
exercises.notes: Sit with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one in front and one to the side. Rotate through the hips to switch which leg is forward.

exercises.name: Couch stretch
exercises.notes: Kneel with your back foot propped against a wall or couch, back knee bent. Squeeze the glute on that side and shift your hips forward.

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.notes: Kneel with your back foot propped against a wall or couch, back knee bent. Squeeze the glute on that side and shift your hips forward.

exercises.name: Hip airplanes
exercises.notes: From a deep lunge, place both hands inside the front foot, rotate your chest toward the ceiling, then return.

exercises.name: Hip circles
exercises.notes: Stand tall, hands on hips. Draw slow, wide circles with your hips like a hula hoop. Keep knees soft and core braced.

exercises.name: Worlds greatest stretch
exercises.notes: From a deep lunge, place both hands inside the front foot, rotate your chest toward the ceiling, then return.

exercises.name: Band external rotations
exercises.notes: Hold a band or dowel with a wide grip. Raise it overhead and behind you without bending the elbows, then return to front.

exercises.name: Band pass throughs
exercises.notes: Hold a light band at shoulder height, arms extended. Pull the band apart by squeezing shoulder blades together, control the return.

exercises.name: Band pull aparts
exercises.notes: Hold a light band at shoulder height, arms extended. Pull the band apart by squeezing shoulder blades together, control the return.

exercises.name: Scapular wall slides
exercises.notes: Stand with forearms against a wall in a goalpost shape. Slide arms overhead while keeping forearms in contact, then return.

exercises.name: Shoulder dislocates
exercises.notes: Hold a band or dowel with a wide grip. Raise it overhead and behind you without bending the elbows, then return to front.

exercises.name: Wall slides

exercises.name: Cat cow
exercises.notes: On hands and knees, alternate between arching the back and rounding it, moving with your breath.

exercises.name: Childs pose
exercises.notes: Sit back onto your heels with arms reached forward, letting your chest sink toward the floor. Breathe into your lower back.

exercises.name: Foam roller
exercises.notes: Stand with your back against a wall, arms in a goalpost position. Slide arms up and down while keeping wrists and lower back in contact with the wall.

exercises.name: Thoracic rotation
exercises.notes: On hands and knees, place one hand behind your head and rotate your elbow toward the ceiling, following with your eyes.

exercises.name: Thread the needle
exercises.notes: From hands and knees, slide one arm underneath your body, rotating your chest toward the floor. Return and repeat.

exercises.name: Bike intervals
exercises.notes: Alternate 30 seconds hard effort with 90 seconds easy pace. Repeat 6-8 rounds.
